notes.albums: Seven albums: retro (6), half zip (2), full zip (1), fan version (12), training set (1), kids set (3), player version (7).
notes.duplicatePhoto: p428 (training set album) and p437 (player album) are the SAME FILE at dHash distance 0 - the navy BETMGM training set, sent twice. Both are claimed by the one listing. That is the third team in this batch where the client repeated a photograph across albums; check every block for it.
notes.dedupe: Only two Tottenham products were live. p436 matched by hash at distance 0; p438 matched by eye - it is the 2026/27 home shirt with the tonal chevron print, photographed on a mannequin here and on a hanger there. p433 looks similar in a thumbnail but has navy and grey shoulder panels, so it is the 2025/26 home and went in as new. Judge white shirts at full resolution.
notes.leadImage: The live 2024/25 player version leads on a SIZE CHART with the garment at index 1; promoted in scripts/lead-image-picks-0906.json. Same fault as the AC Milan block.
notes.seasonReading: Sponsor pins the era: HOLSTEN to 1995, MANSION 2006-2010, AIA 2010 onward; Umbro to 2006, Puma 2006-2012, Under Armour 2012-2017, Nike 2017 onward. The wave, purple and cream shirts cannot be dated from the garment and carry a colour instead.
